en: Attendant
You still have Safari Balls left. Would you like to leave the Safari Zone?
Certainly. Please hand back any Safari Balls you have left.
Did you have fun? Please come again!
Then off you go. Have fun!
Attendant
Did you have fun? Please come again!
Baoba
There you are! I've been waiting for you. Well? What do you think of it? A brand-new Safari Zone!
Oh, I've just had an idea! How would you like to take my Owner Aptitude Test?
What, you'd turn it down? Nobody turns it down! Pass, and you become the Safari Zone's Owner!
Owner... Doesn't it have a lovely ring to it? Go on, take the test!
Ho ho! I'll take that as a yes.
Splendid! It's very simple. Catch a Geodude in my Safari Zone and come and show it to me.
They live in the grass of the Peak Area, up and to the west of the way in. It shouldn't take you long. Good luck!
Baoba
There you are! The second test is ready. This time, catch a Sandshrew and show it to me.
Easy, you think? Not so fast! Sandshrew live only in the Desert Area, out at the far east of my zone.
And over there is my pride and joy: the Area Customizer! One day it will let you lay out my zone's areas any way you please.
For now my twelve areas lie side by side, all open at once. The attendant beside the machine can tell you more.
So, off to the desert with you! Find me a Sandshrew. Good luck!
Attendant
Welcome to the Safari Zone! For just $500, you can play the Safari Game and catch whatever you like. Would you like to play?
Owner! Welcome to the Safari Zone! For just $500, you can play the Safari Game and catch whatever you like. Would you like to play?
That'll be $500, please! And here are your Safari Balls.
{player} received 30 Safari Balls from the attendant.
We'll call you back when your last ball is thrown. Well, have fun out there!
I'm sorry, you don't have enough money. Please come again.
Very well. Please come again!
Attendant
Hello! Is this your first time at the Safari Zone?
Welcome, Owner! Shall I explain how the Safari Zone works?
In the Safari Game you're given 30 Safari Balls to catch Pokémon with. When they're gone, the game is over.
When you meet a Pokémon, you can throw Bait or Mud. Bait makes it stay longer, but it gets harder to catch.
Mud makes it easier to catch, but it might run off. Have fun in the Safari Zone!
Have fun in the Safari Zone!
Attendant
This is the Area Customizer. In time it will let you swap the Safari Zone's areas about and set them in any order.
Every area has Pokémon of its own, so a different layout means different Pokémon to find.
For now the warden has opened all twelve areas side by side, so you can visit any of them. Do try them all!
I'm sorry, but this machine can't be used yet. Warden Baoba has some grand plan for it... or so he says.
Even we don't know what it is. It's a secret.
It's the Area Customizer. Twelve areas are laid out on its screen, side by side.
It's still being finished. Nothing can be changed yet.
It's a large machine. Its screen is dark.
Attendant
This is the Safari Zone Link counter... or it will be. We're not ready yet. Please come back another time.
Attendant
One day, the Safari Zone Link will let you swap Safari Zones with your friends and play in theirs.
We're still getting it ready, though. I'm sorry!
Baoba
Slow down there! When the next test is ready, I'll ring you on your Pokégear. Give me a little time, all right?
Show me the Geodude once you've caught one. They're in the grass of the Peak Area. Good luck!
Oh, splendid! A Geodude from my Safari Zone! You've passed the first test!
...Hm? Didn't I say there were two tests? Becoming the Owner isn't as easy as all that!
The second test is... well, I'm still working on it. I'll ring you on your Pokégear once it's ready.
Show me a Sandshrew once you've caught one. They live in the Desert Area. Good luck!
You did it! A Sandshrew! I knew you could. You've passed! You are now the Owner of the Safari Zone!
I always dreamt of young people having fun in my safari. It gives me ideas, and it helps you fill your Pokédex.
Ah, but even the Owner pays the entrance fee, I'm afraid. We have our reasons! Off you go and enjoy yourself!
The moment I think of something new for the safari, I'll ring you on your Pokégear!
